Hi Hetal,

I saw Boombay is looking for a Graphic Designer to take ownership of brand visuals and packaging across Shopify, Amazon, and marketing touchpoints.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I design over 100 digital and print creatives, building reusable design templates that cut turnaround time while keeping typography and colour systems consistent across print production.

For a similar visual identity and branding focus, you can review my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am based in Nagpur, ready to relocate to Mumbai, and available to discuss how I can help scale Boombay's D2C assets.

Ananya
